note: Legit.ng reviewed current Nigerian retail listings and reported budget-phone prices across the ₦100,000–₦300,000 range on 29 August 2026. These are sampled listings, not a national price index.
IDC forecasts a worldwide 2026 smartphone average selling price of $581, up 27.6% year on year, revised from $550.
Counterpoint reports existing smartphone prices up 15% globally on average so far in 2026; new launches 25% costlier year on year; Middle East & Africa up 18%.

originating_source: NielsenIQ State of the Retail Nation, reported by TechCentral
note: TechCentral reports NielsenIQ's H1 2026 South African smartphone average selling prices rose 9.8% year on year while unit volumes fell 7.9%. This is a retail-sales mix measure, not a controlled device-price index.

originating_source: IDC figure reported secondhand by TechWire Asia
note: A secondary report attributes increases of up to 40–50% in some emerging markets to IDC, but does not identify countries, price bases or a comparable sample. Retained as a quarantined regional report; no country-level value is inferred.
